 Dine & Drink
 Step off Crosby Street and into the greenhouse. NoMo Kitchen sits under a soaring glass ceiling, with exposed brick, chandeliers and greenery at every turn. It’s flooded with daylight at brunch and glowing by dinner. The menu is seasonal American with a well-stamped passport, the cocktails are reason enough to stay for another, and we’re open from first coffee to last call.
 Find us between Howard and Broome, two blocks north of the Canal Street subway.
 Book Now Make A Reservation 
 Hours 
 Breakfast: Mon to Thu, 7am–11am
 Lunch: Mon to Thu, 11am–4pm
 Brunch: Fri to Sun, 7am–3pm
 Dinner: Mon - Thu, 4pm–10pm · Fri–Sat, 3pm–11pm · Sun, 3pm–9pm
 Sip Happens café Daily, 6:30am–3pm
 Brunch Under Glass
 Friday through Sunday, the greenhouse fills with sunlight and the tables fill up fast. Order the ricotta pancakes with berries and candied pistachio (the ones everyone posts), the toasted marshmallow French toast, or the salmon Florentine with spicy hollandaise. Bring the whole group; we have the room.
 Reserve Brunch 
 Seasonal American, Well Travelled
 The classics, done properly, plus a few detours. Start with the Greenhouse Flight of dips or caviar fries for the table. Then it’s the NOMO Burger with aged cheddar and garlic aioli, steak frites with peppercorn jus, or The Crosby Pear flatbread with brie and truffle oil. Plenty for vegan and gluten-free diners, too.
 Menu 
 At the Bar
 Not Your Mom’s Lychee Martini. A Crime of Passion with vodka, passionfruit and prosecco. Low-proof spritzes and zero-proof drinks that get the same care as everything else. Pull up a stool before dinner, or make it the whole evening.
 Menu 
 The Rose Garden
 Just off Crosby Street, our patio is one of SoHo’s rare pockets of outdoor calm: pink roses, deep greenery, and enough distance from the sidewalk to forget it’s there. Open in season for a slow coffee, a working lunch, or a family-style dinner for five or twenty-five.
 Reserve a Table 
 Sip Happens
 Our café for mornings on the move. Lavazza coffee, pastries that change daily, the SoHo Wafflewich, and wellness shots and smoothies made to go. Later on, pick up a local craft beer, a split of prosecco or a mini cocktail. Daily, 6:30am - 3pm.
 Take Over the Greenhouse
 Birthday brunches, bridal showers, team dinners, full buyouts. NoMo Kitchen hosts groups from 10 to 200, with menus built around your event and a room that needs very little decorating. For something smaller, ask about a long table in the Rose Garden.

 Deeply rooted in SoHo
 NoMo lives at the intersection of Nostalgic and Modern: 9 Crosby Street. During the 50s, 60s, and 70s, SoHo became synonymous with fashion, design, art, and culture —serving as an inspirational proving ground for some of the world’s most wayward trendsetters. Today, SoHo is a hotbed of creative up-and-comers, in addition to housing established brands, well-known artists, and cultural icons.
 Here’s what makes NoMo the perfect choice in the middle of it all.
 NOMO KITCHEN
 Enjoy an ever-changing menu of globally-influenced seasonal New American fare and expertly-handcrafted, cocktails.
 ROSE GARDEN
 Wind down. Sip. Meet. Rare among SoHo hotels, our rose garden is a beautiful fresh-air terrace for hanging out any time of day as part of NoMo Kitchen.
 SIP HAPPENS
 Open daily, this grab & go concept offers a selection of coffees, non-coffee drinks and fresh bakery items starting at 7am.
 MEETINGS & EVENTS
 Host unforgettable events at NoMo, chic SoHo venues with penthouse views and versatile layouts, ideal for everything from weddings to pop-up shops.
 GUEST PERKS
 NoMo’s perks invite you to enjoy an exclusive SoHo experience with local discounts.
 OUR SPOT IN SOHO
 Our location on Crosby Street drops you into the heart and soul of the neighborhood, steps away from chic stores housed in old factories.
 FITNESS CENTER
 There’s no need to skip your routine during your stay! Get in a great workout morning, noon or night in our convenient fitness center.
 PET FRIENDLY
 At NoMo, we know your furry friend dreams of visiting the big city too! We are happy to be pet friendly with a $100 cleaning fee.

 Welcome to Horn’s Hook Tavern where American history meets sports fever! Located in the heart of the Upper East Side , our bar captures the spirit of the American Revolution , offering a unique experience that blends patriotism and game day excitement with 8 TV’s and large projector screen!

 LUNCH SPECIALS: Monday-Friday 11-2 
 HAPPY HOUR: Monday-Friday 2-6

 FRIDAY: 9pm - 12am LIVE MUSIC 
 THURSDAY: 4pm - 10pm RAW BAR (except July and August) 
 We have BRUNCH OPTIONS all day, everyday! 
 Whether you're seeking a place to watch the big game with friends, enjoy a delicious meal , or simply soak up the lively atmosphere , Horn’s Hook Tavern is the ultimate destination for sports enthusiasts and history buffs alike.  An instant and enduring success since opening in 2006, this original Boqueria location defined the modern tapas experience in New York City. Inspired by the bustling tapas bars of Barcelona, this vibrant landmark remains a staple for locals and visitors alike. The warm, thoughtfully designed space comes to life at lunch and stays humming through dinner. It’s the neighborhood go-to for Chelsea and Flatiron denizens seeking lively brunches, after-work happy hours, date nights, and group dinners.

 A beloved local gathering place since 2008, Boqueria SoHo channels Barcelona’s energy into Manhattan’s most iconic downtown neighborhood. The authentic tapas, legendary sangrías, and buzzing bar make it the perfect choice for a bite before gallery hopping or shopping in Soho, and a first choice for a date or downtown dinner with friends. Watch chefs slice silky Jamón Ibérico in the open kitchen while you soak in the scene of the always-packed dining room.

 Tucked into the cultural heart of D.C., Boqueria Penn Quarter blends bold Catalan flavors with cosmopolitan flair. Just steps from the National Portrait Gallery and Capital One Arena, it's a favorite haunt for power-lunchers, theatergoers, and night owls alike. By day, it’s paella with purpose. By night, the room hums with the clink of sangría glasses and the vibe of a bustling Spanish tapas bar. Slide into a bar seat for one of the city’s most coveted Happy Hours—or gather your crew for the legendary Boqueria brunch.

 In Chicago’s West Loop, Boqueria pulses with the energy of Barcelona and the flavor of the city’s most electric dining district. Locals crowd the lively bar and polished dining room for satisfying lunches and spirited dinners—think succulent jamón, garlicky gambas al ajillo, and classic patatas bravas. Every toast lands sweeter over showstopping sangrías, craft cocktails, and attention-grabbing Spanish wines. Happy Hour draws the after-work crowd, while savvy weekenders book early to claim the city’s most coveted brunch tables.

 A DESTINATION
 Calling on traditional Jamaican ingredients and techniques, Jumieka NYC (pronounced juh· may ·kuh) brings you the warmth of the Caribbean. Jumieka’s offerings pay homage to Chef H. Kemis Lawrence's upbringing surrounded by the flavors and cuisine of his home country, Jamaica.
 Dine with us
 Located conveniently at at The Hugh in Midtown, our spacious location offers ample seating to dine in, work, and connect with friends. Join us for happy hour, dinner, or Saturday lunch. 
 Visit Us 
 OUR DELICIOUS CARIBBEAN DISHES 
 A delectable menu curated by the iconic Caribbean chef, Kemis Law. Our menu offers a taste of traditional carribean specialities with a modern twist, like our Jerk Burrito and coconut rum punch. Come try it for yourself and enjoy an experience that transports you to Jamaica with every bite. 
 CATERING OPTIONS 
 We offer cater options for every occasion. Whether it’s a birthday party, corporate gathering, wedding, or mixer - we’ve got the team equipped to satisfy your catering needs. 
 MASTER CHEF 
 Chef Kemis has worked with the top Carribean restaurants in NYC, such as Miss Lily’s, Caribbean Social, Negril Village and more! His latest restaurant project, Jumieka NYC, embodies the best of his culinary experiences and is wholly family owned and operated. 
 View Menu
 COCKTAILS 
 JOIN US FOR HAPPY HOUR 
 Join us from Monday through Friday from 5 - 7 PM EST for our exciting happy hour cocktail menu. We offer speciality cocktails, traditional Caribbean beers, and wine to compliment our entrees and dishes.

 Our Story
 Kinoko is New Orleans native,  Kelseay  Dukae's take on American- Japanese sushi and other Asian fusion dishes with hints of heer Cajun roots. Kinoko translates to mushroom, a highly celebrated ingredient throughout the vegan – friendly menu.  There is a focus on sustainability and seasonality, offering specials with local and ethically sourced fish and seasonal veggies! 
 Contact Us 
 Come enjoy our seasonal menus and unique dishes. 
 Get Locations 
 "Until I discovered cooking I was never really interested in anything"
 Chef Kelseay Dukae, a New Orleans native, brings a bold and unexpected perspective to Kinoko—her take on American-Japanese sushi and Asian-inspired cuisine infused with subtle nods to her Cajun roots. Blending the precision of traditional sushi techniques with the soulful, flavor-forward influence of New Orleans, her dishes strike a balance between refinement and comfort, creating a style that is both unique and deeply personal.
 At Kinoko—named after the Japanese word for mushroom, a celebrated ingredient throughout the menu—Chef Kelseay embraces a philosophy rooted in seasonality, sustainability, and creativity. The menu highlights vegan-friendly offerings alongside thoughtfully sourced seafood, featuring ethically caught fish and locally sourced produce whenever possible. Each dish is designed to showcase natural flavors, layered textures, and a sense of place that reflects both her Southern upbringing and her passion for Asian cuisine.
 More than just a menu, Kinoko represents Chef Kelseay’s vision of modern dining—where cultural influences intersect, and every detail is intentional. From delicate sushi rolls to inventive fusion plates, her approach is guided by a respect for ingredients, a commitment to quality, and a desire to create an experience that feels fresh, memorable, and distinctly her own.

 Celebrating 15 years 
Gracias New York City!
 Welcome to Salinas, an Award Winning Spanish Restaurant & Cocktail Bar in the Heart of NYC
 Since opening its doors in 2011, Salinas has had one mission: bring the flavors and spirit of Spain to NYC. Started by Nicolas Matar, Mary Catherine Mikula, and Donald Mikula, this West Chelsea gem has become a go-to spot for anyone craving authentic Spanish cuisine. Chef Luis Bollo has been in the kitchen since day one. He solidified his partnership shortly afterwards.
 Read More 
 Tapas Rooted in Tradition and Creativity
 From day one, Salinas set out to do more than serve tapas. The team wanted guests to feel transported — like they were dining on Spain’s Mediterranean coast. The menu features a mix of classic small plates and innovative dishes inspired by regional flavors. Chef Luis Bollo, originally from San Sebastián in Basque Country, brings deep knowledge and heart to every plate. After working in Michelin-starred kitchens, he now channels that experience into dishes that balance rustic charm with refined technique.
 Critical Acclaim and Culinary Recognition
 Salinas hasn’t gone unnoticed. The restaurant received a 2-star review from The New York Times — a big honor in NYC’s food scene. Food critics have praised its thoughtful tapas and inventive take on Spanish classics. Guests consistently point out the bold flavors, balanced textures, and consistent execution.
 A Dining Space That Transports
 The interior, designed by Mary Catherine and Donald Mikula, was inspired by the Balearic Islands. Natural materials like limestone and Brazilian walnut create a warm, welcoming vibe. Velvet seating and custom touches make the space feel cozy yet upscale. The restaurant features three distinct rooms: a front lounge, a main dining area, and a garden room with a retractable roof and stone fireplace — perfect for year-round al fresco dining.
 More Than Just Dinner — It's an Experience
 Guests often mention the attentive service and helpful staff. Servers guide guests through the menu and suggest ideal wine pairings. Favorites like Langostinos al Ajillo and Pa Amb Oli keep guests coming back. The romantic atmosphere — complete with Balearic sounds and soft lighting — also earns high marks.
 Join Us
 Whether it’s a casual night or a celebration, Salinas offers more than a meal — it delivers a piece of Spain, right here in New York City.

 Yong Chuan - New York, NY
 About Yong Chuan 
 YongChuan is a modern upscale restaurant in New York City's culturally vibrant Lower East Side. The restaurant derives its name from the fusion of Ningbo and Szechuan. YongChuan offers a diverse culinary experience that celebrates the rich flavors of these two distinct regional Chinese cuisines. 
 Learn more about us 
 Groups & Parties 
 Gather Over Bold Flavors
 From birthdays to special celebrations, we bring friends and families together with vibrant Chinese cuisine. Enjoy shareable favorites like Peking duck, dim sum, and seafood in a welcoming setting - perfect for group dining and memorable moments.

 Catering 
 Authentic Chinese Cuisine For Your Event
 Bring the bold, regional flavors of YongChuan to your next gathering. Our catering menu offers a variety of appetizing trays and dishes - from dumplings and wontons to stir-fried specialties and rice classics-crafted to delight every guest, big or small.

 About us
 YongChuan is a modern upscale restaurant in New York City's culturally vibrant Lower East Side. The restaurant derives its name from the fusion of Ningbo and Szechuan. YongChuan offers a diverse culinary experience that celebrates the rich flavors of these two distinct regional Chinese cuisines.
